title: The Symbiotic Liability Trap - Digital Edition
abstract: The Complete Works digital Edition consolidates the seven papers of The Symbiotic Liability Trap publication series into a single authoritative volume, comprising the doctrinal core, the structural thesis, the methodological note, and four empirical case studies. The work examines the structural failure mode of cross-domain compliance under fault-based criminal liability, developing the concepts of the Authority Artifact, the Janus Property, the Cross-Media Shift, and Pseudo-Recognisability across process engineering, environmental criminal law, regulatory standard-setting, and AI governance.
